create_monolingual_dataset: create a MonolingualDataset wrapper for monolingual data with source and target vocabularies
collate_samples: collate a list of monolingual samples into a padded mini-batch tensor dictionary
make_source_target: make source and target tensors from future and past shifted sentence targets
filter_vocab: filter target tokens to replace out-of-vocabulary indices with the unknown token
ordered_indices: return an ordered list of indices for batching with optional shuffling by size
